messages:
jordan_acme: Morning team — after we rotated IdP signing certs our users started hitting 403s during SSO. Saw it first around 06:16 UTC.
sarah_support: Ugh, sorry — can you paste the exact error from your app logs? Any other infra changes this morning?
jordan_acme: App log shows 'SAML assertion recipient mismatch' when the Assertion posts back to our ACS. We recently pushed an nginx path normalization at the LB that adds trailing slashes. Our SP is configured as https://app.acme.acme-corp.com/sso/consume (no trailing slash). IdP metadata references https://app.acme.acme-corp.com/sso/consume/ (with trailing slash). Cert rotation happened ~06:14.
devon_ssr: Classic. If the Assertion Recipient equals the ACS URL in the metadata (with trailing slash) but your SP canonical ACS has no trailing slash, and the LB is redirecting the POST, the SP will reject. Do you see a redirect when hitting the ACS?
ingrid_eng: Quick repro I ran from our CI box: 
```
$ curl -I -L https://app.acme.acme-corp.com/sso/consume
HTTP/1.1 302 Found\nLocation: https://app.acme.acme-corp.com/sso/consume/\n
```
And metadata from IdP shows: 
```
<AssertionConsumerService Binding=\"urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST\" Location=\"https://app.acme.acme-corp.com/sso/consume/\"/>\n
```
sarah_support: That lines up. When the IdP signs the Assertion the Recipient equals the ACS in metadata (with slash), but your SP compares against its configured ACS (no slash). If the LB rewrites/redirects before the POST hits the app, validation fails. ops_bot any log of the cert rotation?
ops_bot: idp-deploy-bot: rotation completed at 2026-03-15T06:14:59Z. New metadata published (includes ACS with trailing slash).
jordan_acme: What's the minimum-impact fix for live traffic? Change metadata or change LB behavior? We can't push app code right away.
devon_ssr: Two pragmatic options: 1) Reconfigure LB to stop injecting the trailing slash for /sso/consume (fast). 2) If LB change is risky, publish a second ACS entry in your SP config to accept the alternate URL (or enable a tolerant flag so SP accepts normalized recipients).
ingsrid_eng: Another fast mitigation is to add the old signing cert into the IdP metadata as an additional <KeyDescriptor use=\"signing\"> entry (if you still have it) so in-flight Assertions signed by the previous cert validate during the rotation window — but that only helps the cert boundary, not the recipient mismatch.
sarah_support: We usually advise: keep both certs during a rolling rotation for ~48h, and ensure ACS values in IdP metadata exactly match the SP's post URL (including trailing slash behaviour).
jordan_acme: I can flip the LB rewrite off quickly and also add the old cert into metadata (we still have the old PEM). How to add cert chunk quickly?
ingsrid_eng: Edit the metadata XML and add: 
```
<KeyDescriptor use=\"signing\">\n  <KeyInfo><X509Data><X509Certificate>MIID...OLDCERTBASE64...Q==</X509Certificate></X509Data></KeyInfo>\n</KeyDescriptor>\n
```
Then push the metadata update in the IdP admin console. That buys you time for caches to flush.
devon_ssr: After you do that, test a login and paste the app log lines (redact emails). We want to see a POST arrive and assertion verification. Also check any CDN/LB fronted 302s in access logs.
jordan_acme: Done — removed trailing-slash rewrite and re-uploaded metadata with the old cert. Performed a test login at 07:03 UTC, app logs: 
```
[sso] INFO Received SAMLResponse, Recipient=https://app.acme.acme-corp.com/sso/consume
[sso] INFO Assertion signature verified (thumbprint 1F:2A:3C:...)
[sso] INFO Session created for user=jordan@acme-corp.com
```
sarah_support: Nice, that confirms it's fixed. Follow-ups we recommend: 
- Keep both certs in metadata for at least 48 hours.
- Align LB rewrite rules with SP/IdP canonical ACS (best: make SP tolerant to normalized recipients).
- Add an automated preflight check that compares configured SP ACS vs IdP metadata ACS and alerts on mismatch (trailing slash, http vs https, port differences).
devon_ssr: I'll log an internal docs task to add a SAML rotation checklist: include steps to add old cert to metadata, verify ACS exact match, and a reminder to avoid path-normalizing rewrites on ACS endpoints.
ingsrid_eng: Also adding a small feature suggestion: sso.accept_alternate_recipients config flag so ops can flip acceptance of both exact and normalized ACS during rotations.
jordan_acme: Thanks everyone — saved the login flow and will keep the old cert in metadata for a day. Appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
sarah_support: Glad it's resolved — reopen if anything else crops up. We'll follow up with a short incident summary and add the runbook notes.
